div.head: IV Eg 14.1
div.ab: Þonne wille ic, þæt symble mid eow gehealden sý þæt ge to friþes bote gecoren hæfdon mid miclum wisdome ⁊ me swyðe gecwemlice.
Þonne wille ic, þæt symble mid eow gehealden sý þæt ge to friðes bote gecoren hæfdon mid micclum wisdome ⁊ me swyðe gecwemlice.
Þonne wille ic þæt symble mid eow gehealden sý þæt ge to friðes bote gecoren hæfdon mid micclum wisdome ⁊ me swyðe gecwemlice.
Further, it is my will that the provisions which you have made, with great wisdom and very acceptably to me, for the improvement of public security be continually observed among you.
Zwar bei euch will ich, dass immerfort beobachtet werde, was ihr mit viel Weisheit und mir höchst wohlgefällig zur Besserung der öffentlichen Sicherheit [zum Recht] erwählt hattet.
Among you, indeed, I will that what you had chosen [as law] for the improvement of public security, with much wisdom and very pleasingly to me, be observed for ever.
div.note: Not in the Latin Versio. Liebermann compares IV Eg 2.1.
